body_text:
Bring Back the Shine: Why Your Hair Feels Dull and Faded

You’ve spent time and money on beautiful hair color—so why does it suddenly feel dull, brassy, or lifeless just a few weeks later? Color fading is a common issue caused by sun exposure, hot tools, shampoo, and even hard water. You might notice your once-vibrant blonde turning yellow, brunettes losing richness, or reds going flat. Worse, the shine and silky texture you left the salon with? Gone.

But here’s the good news: you don’t need a full color appointment to get your glow back. A professional hair gloss treatment is the secret weapon to refreshing your color, boosting shine, and making your hair feel like new again.

How Gloss Services Work at Studio One

At Studio One, we make it easy to keep your color looking fresh without spending extra time in the chair. Our gloss services can be added to your color appointment with no added time—or scheduled as a stand-alone treatment.

We use a high-performance gloss that doesn’t just enhance color—it also conditions the hair while sealing the cuticle for maximum shine. Whether you're touching up highlights, refreshing an all-over tone, or just craving a glossy glow, our gloss treatments deliver.

Benefits of a Hair Gloss:

Adds shine and luminosity to dull or dry hair

Balances out faded or brassy tones between full color sessions

Helps hair feel healthier and more hydrated thanks to our conditioning formula

Comes in tinted or clear, depending on your needs

Can be done at every color appointment for ongoing maintenance

Great for all hair types and textures

Hair Gloss for Gray Blending: A Gentle Intro to Color

Not ready to commit to permanent color? A hair gloss is the perfect way to camouflage gray hair without going all in. The gloss gently stains gray strands, helping them blend in with the rest of your natural hair for a soft, dimensional look.

While it’s not permanent, it’s a fantastic option if you're just starting to notice grays—or if you're curious about what color could look like on you. Think of it as a low-pressure, high-reward way to dip your toes into the world of professional color without the commitment.

Hair Gloss Pricing at Studio One

At Studio One Hair Design, our gloss pricing is simple and flexible:

Add-On Gloss with Any Color Service: $45

Stand-Alone Gloss Treatment + Blowout: $90

This includes a professional blowout and style, so you leave feeling as refreshed as your hair looks.

Ready for Healthier, Shinier Hair?

If your hair has lost its sparkle or your color just doesn’t feel quite right, a gloss may be exactly what you need. It's quick, affordable, and gives you that fresh-from-the-salon finish—without the full color process.

Let’s bring your hair back to life, one gloss at a time.
